units.translation: ⟦1⟧ as at ⟦2⟧ 395; since Homer ⟦3⟧ with accusative is also used for the question 'where'. I would also not take offense at ⟦4⟧ (for those in the know) ⟦5⟧. ⟦6⟧ explains itself; ⟦7⟧ Critias 2, 11 Bgk. Choral strophe ⟦8⟧, 956-967. Trochees at beginning and end; in the middle dactyls, a pentapody and three tripodies, of which the first is catalectic; before them and after the pentapody ⟦9⟧ = ⟦10⟧. That looks like a dochmiac dimeter; but dochmiacs are impossible here. Rossbach-Westphal take the second part as a catalectic-dactylic tripody like the following, but ⟦11⟧ as 「「「「「, i.e. as iambic, which seems to me hardly less inadmissible than the dochmiacs. If, however, one reads ⟦12⟧ and treats the antistrophe accordingly, one has a catalectic pentapody as at 534. The blessing of the first antistrophe refers to the preservation of youth and at length to happy marriages: as if the Erinyes now thought differently about this too than before (212 ff. 605). ⟦13⟧ 248; ⟦14⟧ as ⟦15⟧ in the Attic skolion (2 Bgk.), ⟦16⟧ ⟦17⟧ (also Soph. and Eurip.). So the Suppliants 678 ff.: ⟦18⟧. – ⟦19⟧ 960 the marriage gods, besides Aphrodite Hera ⟦20⟧ and Zeus ⟦21⟧ (214 f.), to whom the Moirai now are added, cf. Pollux 3, 38 (above on 835), ⟦22⟧ 217. ⟦23⟧ sisters on the mother's side, according to Hesiod Theog. 217; all these children of Night have no father according to Hesiod. ⟦24⟧ 354, ⟦25⟧; ⟦26⟧ (only here) ruling mightily at all times with their just intervention (⟦27⟧ 57 etc.).
and a dimming mist settles upon their eyes
and you, goddesses Moirai, sisters from the same mother
through wrath, the ruin of reciprocal vengeance
and let no man-slaying destruction come upon this city, laying it waste
a marriage fated for man and wife
Athena expresses her great satisfaction at the reconciliation achieved through good words.

⟦1⟧ is otherwise always active without middle, and therefore some construe: ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ (pass.) ⟦4⟧, which cannot please. Either, then, the middle is to be recognized here after all (they grant from their power, and cf. (⟦5⟧)⟦6⟧ 367. 425; ⟦7⟧ 379; Paley on ⟦8⟧), or ⟦9⟧ is to be written. The epic ⟦10⟧ A. has only here.
